scope: Synthetic ordinary CALL/CREATE through state_dry_runner.DryRunner.Apply over a complete in-memory committed trie; no native dispatch, RPC defaults/formatting, estimates, traces, RocksDB, network replay, persistence, or production routing claim

fixture_schema.state_before/state_after: committed descriptor plus account/code/slot reads and encoded seed rows
fixture_schema.cases[].input: caller-supplied transaction fields before DryRunner nonce replacement
fixture_schema.cases[].output: effective nonce and exact vm.ExecutionResult fields returned by DryRunner
fixture_schema.repeated: two independent applications of the same call against the same committed state

public_local.semantic_note: The bounded DryRunner source and outputs are identical at the public/local pins. The local pin additionally contains concrete-state lifecycle work outside this public API fixture.
